prompt: Use case: identity-preserve narrative restaging. First inputs canonical identity portraits; next room master is only architectural/palette reference; LAST input is prior scene for cast, approved face morphology and exact task content, NOT a pose to preserve. Preserve each canonical face, adult age, hair, eye/nose/jaw proportions and characteristic accessories. Farah lens anatomical LEFT eye; Demir comms anatomical RIGHT ear; Nazari and Mirza have no eyewear. Balanced stylized adult head/body scale, neither oversized heads nor realistic tiny heads. Clean cel-shaded adventure-comic linework, natural supported anatomy, two arms per character. Restage Demir working alone at an engineering desk, seated sideways in a supported chair with torso and head naturally aligned toward a low sloping evaluation console. Remove the tablet display held toward the camera. His stylus follows the first two columns of the fixture, his other hand rests on the keyboard, brow furrowed in concentration and eyes on the data. Camera sees his recognizable three-quarter face from beside the work. Console has a compact table headed Synthetic evaluation: Actual10,20,30,40; LSTM12,18,30,40; Attention8,22,30,40; Kalman10,20,33,37. Small line Prior errors:0.045,0.038,0.058. Two unfilled result fields Member and blend MAEs:pending and Beats best:pending. No calculated result, probability, success badge or invented graph. Typography and grid precisely share the tilted screen plane. Background screens and wrist terminal off; any nearby notebook is closed with a plain cover. Natural two shoulder-elbow-wrist chains, realistic stylus and keyboard contact, exact canonical face and adult head size. Warm local lamp, charcoal workshop, muted sage and aged brass without fluorescent edge stripes. Output one full 1536x1024 scene. No text outside genuine work artifacts, no captions, no hero portraits, no camera-facing eye contact or lesson cards.
